title: Supplementary Materials from: Anion Exchange Mechanism of PFAS with Cholestyramine: Implications for PFAS Removal from the Human Body
description: This record contains the supplementary calculation records, molecular structures, molecular dynamics trajectories, analysis and plotting materials, tables, figures, workflow code, and Streamlit interface source associated with the study "Anion Exchange Mechanism of PFAS with Cholestyramine: Implications for PFAS Removal from the Human Body." The deposited materials support the reported density functional theory, energy-decomposition, potential-energy-surface, and molecular dynamics analyses.
